notes.title: Steam SHMUP Fest & Community Discord Server Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/896818002165633105/1155914741865267340/SHMUP_1920x1080.png[/img]

[h1]Steam SHMUP Fest[/h1]
[b]Void Rush will be attending[/b] its first Steam festival which is [b]the SHMUP fest[/b]! 🥳

During the festival, you can play a pretty early combat demo of Void Rush and let us know what you think about it in the discussions section or the community Discord server.

We will be trying to update the demo every day of the festival and the following week to deliver the best experience for you. After two weeks, the demo will be unavailable.

[h1]Community Discord Server[/h1]
[b]The community[/b] now has a [b]Discord server[/b] where members can post what they think about Void Rush!

You can [url=https://discord.gg/URDu2eSmZh]join the server by clicking here[/url]. 👀

[h1]Finally...[/h1]
Publishing a demo on Steam was one of the milestones for us, and we are happy to share it with you! Please [b]do not hesitate[/b] to jump into the discussions section or the community Discord server to [b]throw questions and feedback at us[/b].

See you in the next update!
